## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC IPO and target search

- 2025-05-12: EGH Acquisition Corp. closes $150M Cayman SPAC IPO (Nasdaq EGHA)

#### Hecate Business Combination announcement

- 2026-01-21: Business Combination Agreement signed with Hecate Energy Group, LLC and Hecate Holdings LLC
- 2026-01-27: 8-K filed disclosing the BCA (Ex 2.1); form-of TRA embedded as Exhibit C with placeholder preamble date `[bullet], 2026` and unidentified PubCo name and Agent

## Explanation

EGH Acquisition Corp. is a Cayman SPAC that signed a Business Combination Agreement with Hecate Energy Group, LLC and Hecate Holdings LLC on January 21, 2026, establishing a standard Up-C structure at closing under which EGH redomesticates to Delaware, issues Class V common stock to Hecate Holdings, and enters into a Tax Receivable Agreement with Hecate Holdings as TRA Holder. The form-of TRA attached as Exhibit C to the BCA pays 85% of net realized tax benefits from basis step-ups under future exchanges of Parent Hecate Units (paired with Class V shares) for Class A common stock, plus imputed interest deductions on payments. The form-of remains unexecuted: preamble date, post-domestication PubCo name, and Agent identity are all placeholders, with execution scheduled concurrent with closing. As of the Q1 2026 10-Q (period ending March 31, 2026) the Hecate Business Combination has not closed; the BCA outside date is May 11, 2027. Status is `Unknown` pending the closing 8-K or a BCA termination filing. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
